messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGE -> @eng-oncall (sev2). p99 latency on cont-batch path spiked above 2.8s for 6m. Streaming stall count +120% vs baseline. Affected zone: us-west-2. Model: open-llm-v2. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/contbatch/overview
Riley M: I'm looking. Graphs show p95 steady ~180ms, p99 jumped to ~3s, tail concentrated on nodes with highest mixed-seqlen ratio.
Priya S: saw high padding amplification: many small short requests getting co-batched with a few long ones (seqlen > 1200), effective batch run time increased ~2.5x. KV cache miss rate up ~30% on those nodes.
Jorge D: any recent scheduler or preemption flag changes?
Riley M: nothing deployed in the last 3 hours. Autoscaler did a reschedule event at 09:02 (scale-up), could have evicted warmed KV partitions.
Sam W: immediate mitigations we can try: reduce contbatch_max_tokens, enable per-tenant seqlen isolation, flip scheduler to round-robin by seqlen weight, or temporarily route long sequences to the fallback non-batch path.
Priya S: doing a quick config flip: lowering contbatch.max_tokens from 2048 -> 1024 via feature flag (console). This should cap max padding per batch.
Priya S: patch applied at 09:10:07.
SupportBot: Notifying support channel about potential customer impact (tenants with heavy long inputs).
Riley M: after lowering max_tokens, immediate reduction in extreme batch durations. p99 dropped to ~1.6s within 70s. But we still see intermittent ~>2s events tied to one tenant (tenant: org-887).
Jorge D: enabling seqlen-based routing for org-887 to force streaming-only path for seqlen>800 so they don't create padding amplification for others. I'll push routing rule now.
Jorge D: routing rule applied at 09:14:55. Rule: if model==open-llm-v2 and seqlen>800 and tenant==org-887 -> route:streaming-fallback.
Priya S: adding preemptive yielding on batcher (allow 'stream' slices to preempt contiguous batch execution). Flipping to true.
Riley M: preemptive_yield toggle applied at 09:15:30. Small roll restart of batcher pods initiated.
IncidentsBot: rollout: deployment/batcher restarted by Priya S at 09:15:35  status: success (4/4 pods ready).
Sam W: monitoring tail - initial signs good. p99 now ~0.9s. KV miss rate trending down.
SupportBot: Support update: org-887 notified with suggested mitigation: reduce max prompt length or split requests; CSM loop opened.
Priya S: temporary mitigation summary: - contbatch.max_tokens=1024 - preemptive_yield=true - routing rule for org-887 seqlen>800 -> streaming-fallback.
Riley M: next steps (post-incident): 1) implement seqlen-aware batch caps (dynamic max_tokens based on observed seqlen histogram) 2) scheduler fairness metric (seqlen-weighted latency) panel in grafana 3) KV shard affinity improvement to avoid eviction on scale events 4) evaluate hybrid strategy: allow bounded co-batching but enforce max wall-time per batch to allow preemption.
Jorge D: creating follow-up tickets: RB-1509 (dynamic-seqlen-batching), RB-1510 (batcher-preempt-window), RB-1511 (kv-shard-stability). Adding org-887 as impacted tenant for prioritization.
Priya S: adding quick runbook entry: emergency knobs to reduce contbatch.max_tokens, enable preemptive_yield, and routing snippet. Example curl to toggle flag: 
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"contbatch.max_tokens","value":"1024"}' \
  https://console.redwood.internal/api/flags
```
Riley M: summary & handoff: root cause hypothesis - mixed sequence lengths + cold KV partitions after scale event caused padding amplification leading to very long in-flight contiguous batches; streaming slices stalled behind them. Mitigations taken restored p99 to acceptable range.
Priya S: handing off to night oncall (@Sam W). Please monitor p99 and if it rises above 2s for >5m, revert contbatch.max_tokens=512 and escalate to eng-sre.
Sam W: ack. I'll monitor for next 6 hours and keep routing fallback for org-887 active for 3 hours.
IncidentBot: Annotated incident: severity=sev2, start=3524689012, mitigations=[contbatch.max_tokens->1024, preemptive_yield=true, routing_fallback(org-887 seqlen>800)], handoff=Sam W at 3524689600.
SupportBot: closing notification loop with support and CSMs; ticket created for org-887 impact summary.
Jorge D: note: will run a controlled load test tomorrow to validate scheduler preemption semantics with mixed seqlen traffic.
Priya S: monitoring 30m after mitigation: p99 ~0.85s, no new alerts. Will draft postmortem and include graphs for padding amplification and KV miss correlation.
